research_question: Does learned invariant-base hand raising retain complete physical qualification across 20 unseen impulse directions per task?
primary_endpoint: Qualified success requires every requested wrist COM to reach 0.88 m and rise 0.20 m, zero terminations and failed environment steps, minimum root height above 0.64 m, and maximum tilt below 0.50 rad.
claim_gates: all 120 task-method-seed cells complete from one clean revision
the fixed base fails at least one validation run for every task
the learned invariant base qualifies all 60 validation runs
simulator evidence is not hardware evidence
pilot_note: This validation extension was frozen only after the separate five-seed confirmatory study passed. No policy training or severity selection uses these 20 validation seeds.
